title_original: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Construction of Railroads and Maintenance of Railroad Facilities) <Presidential Decree No. 29617, March 12, 2019>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on March 14, 2019.

Articles 2 and 3
Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through <28> Omitted.

<29> The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion and Support of the Railroad Logistics Industry shall be partially amended as follows:

In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 4 (1), "Railroad Construction Act" shall be replaced with "Act on the Construction of Railroads and Maintenance of Railroad Facilities."

<30> through <33> Omitted.
